# Controls and evidence

| Control | What it does | Steps | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **C-AUTH** Short-lived signed tokens, checked on every request | Keycloak OIDC; RS256 only, issuer, audience, expiry and allowed clients checked; 401 vs 403. | 16, 17 | `services/rag-api/tests/test_auth.py::test_bad_tokens_get_401` |
| **C-AUTHZ** Policy-as-code authorisation with pre-filter and post-check | OPA decides actions and the visible documents; the filter goes into every query; every result is re-checked. | 18, 32, 33 | `policies/rag/authz/authz_test.rego`<br>`services/rag-api/tests/test_policy.py::test_search_applies_the_policy_filter`<br>`services/rag-api/tests/test_answer_api.py::test_opa_post_check_reaches_the_model` |
| **C-STORE-ACL** Access enforced inside every store, proven by one conformance kit | pgvector, Postgres FTS, Qdrant and OpenSearch filter by tenant, classification and groups in the query; the search pipeline re-checks. | 11, 12, 13, 31, 32 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_stores.py::test_pgvector_conforms`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_retrieval.py::test_pipeline_drops_what_a_buggy_store_leaks` |
| **C-RLS** Tenant isolation by row-level security | The database itself returns only the tenant set for the transaction; nothing set means nothing returned. | 36 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_lifecycle.py::test_row_level_security_isolates_tenants` |
| **C-SESSION** Conversations belong to one person and expire | Memory keys combine tenant, person and session; TTL; erasure by person. | 33, 36 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_answer.py::test_memory_makes_follow_ups_work_and_is_per_person`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_lifecycle.py::test_valkey_memory_forgets_one_person` |
| **C-CACHE** Answer caches keyed by who can see what, reset by every change | Cache key includes the access fingerprint, prompt, model, settings and an index epoch bumped by ingestion and access changes. | 33, 36 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_answer.py::test_cache_hits_are_per_access_and_end_with_ingestion`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_lifecycle.py::test_revocation_reaches_search_answers_cache_and_manifest` |
| **C-PII** Personal data redacted before indexing and in questions and answers | Checksummed detectors; mask, keyed pseudonym or remove at ingestion; input and output PII guards. | 31, 34 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_parsing_cleaning.py::test_pii_strategies`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_guards.py::test_personal_data_never_reaches_memory_or_cache` |
| **C-INJECTION** Prompt-injection and jailbreak guards, measured in CI | Input patterns (incl. base64), poisoned-document removal, optional model judge or vendor service; catch and false-positive gate. | 24, 34 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_guards.py::test_poisoned_document_is_dropped_before_the_model`<br>`examples/eval/guards.yaml` |
| **C-OUTPUT** Output guards for secrets, personal data and toxicity | Answers are checked against key/token patterns, PII detectors and a toxicity list before release. | 34 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_guards.py::test_output_pii_secrets_and_toxicity` |
| **C-GROUND** Grounded answers with checked citations and honest abstention | Numbered sources, citation validation, abstain without hits, uncited policy, groundedness guard, corrective and self-reflective options. | 33, 34, 35 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_answer.py::test_citations_are_checked_against_the_context`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_guards.py::test_groundedness_checks_words_and_exact_numbers` |
| **C-AUDIT** Tamper-evident audit log of every search and answer, without text | Hash-chained, anchored to object storage; ids, versions, guard verdicts, outcomes; recorded before data leaves. | 23, 33, 34 | `tests/test_audit_chain.py::test_verify_passes_on_a_clean_log`<br>`services/rag-api/tests/test_answer_api.py::test_no_audit_no_answer` |
| **C-EVAL** Evaluation gates on every change | Retrieval, answer, guard and architecture gates in CI; golden datasets; baselines. | 26, 32, 34, 35 | `evals/gates.yaml`<br>`libs/rag-evals/tests/test_gates.py`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_retrieval.py::test_eval_search_gate_and_errors` |
| **C-PROMPTS** Versioned, locked, reviewed prompts | Prompt registry with a lock file; labels per environment; promotion by pull request; refs recorded with every answer. | 24 | `libs/rag-common/tests/test_prompts.py::test_the_real_registry_is_valid` |
| **C-CARDS** Model, dataset and system cards with lineage | Cards for every model, dataset and the system; lineage events from ingestion. | 25 | `libs/rag-common/tests/test_cards.py`<br>`docs/cards/system-rag-api.md` |
| **C-SECRETS** Dynamic, short-lived secrets from files, never config or env in containers | OpenBao issues database logins per pod; keys rendered to files and re-read on rotation. | 6, 28, 32 | `tests/test_vault.py`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_retrieval.py::test_secrets_come_from_files_and_rotate` |
| **C-SUPPLY** Pinned, scanned, signed supply chain | Actions pinned to commits, dependency and licence checks, SBOM, image signing and attestation, digest-pinned deploys. | 27, 29 | `tests/test_ci_policy.py::test_actions_are_pinned_to_a_commit_with_its_version_noted`<br>`tests/test_licences.py`<br>`.github/workflows/release.yml` |
| **C-DEPLOY** Deploy and roll back by pull request, guarded by admission policies | GitOps with Argo CD; hardened workloads; unpinned images refused; rollback is a revert. | 29, 37 | `tests/test_k8s.py::test_rag_api_workload_is_hardened`<br>`tests/test_promote.py` |
| **C-OBSERVE** Traces, metrics and alerts without personal text | OpenTelemetry spans per stage, SLOs and alerts, masked LLM traces, guard verdict metrics. | 19, 20, 21, 22, 34 | `services/rag-api/tests/test_telemetry.py::test_no_token_and_no_question_text_in_any_span` |
| **C-FEEDBACK** User feedback tied to each answer | Thumbs up/down with a fixed reason list, audited, joined to traces by answer id. | 33, 37 | `services/rag-api/tests/test_answer_api.py::test_feedback` |
| **C-LIFECYCLE** Retention, erasure and immediate revocation | Retention rules, erasure of sources (all object versions), of a person's conversations and cached answers, and access changes in every store at once. | 36 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_lifecycle.py::test_retention_dry_run_then_apply`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_lifecycle.py::test_erase_source_removes_every_version_and_every_copy`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_lifecycle.py::test_revocation_reaches_search_answers_cache_and_manifest` |
| **C-BACKUP** Backups with restore drills | Custom-format dumps with a checksum and row-count receipt, uploaded to locked storage; a drill restores and compares. | 36 | `tests/test_backup.py::test_backup_and_restore_drill` |
| **C-LIMITS** Limits on cost and blast radius | Gateway budgets and rate limits, input size guard, SQL authorizer with step and row limits, agent step limits. | 10, 34, 35 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_architectures.py::test_sql_authorizer_allows_only_reads_of_permitted_tables`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_guards.py::test_pii_topics_and_size` |
| **C-RESILIENCE** Degrade, don't fail | Rerankers and helpers fail open (counted); planners and SQL fall back to documents; extractive fallback generator. | 32, 33, 35 | `libs/rag-core/tests/test_retrieval.py::test_reranker_failure_is_fail_open_by_default`<br>`libs/rag-core/tests/test_architectures.py::test_agentic_falls_back_when_the_planner_fails` |
| **C-TRANSPARENCY** People know they're using AI, see sources, and can't be misled by refusals | System card, cited sources in every answer, fixed messages for blocked or out-of-scope questions, AI disclosure in the client. | 25, 33, 34 | `docs/cards/system-rag-api.md`<br>`services/rag-api/tests/test_answer_api.py::test_guard_block_shows_a_message_and_audits_the_reason` |
| **C-OVERSIGHT** Human oversight and escalation | Abstention instead of guesses, referral messages for out-of-scope topics, runbooks, feedback review, kill switch by rollback. | 29, 33, 34, 37 | `docs/runbooks/rag-policy-mismatch.md`<br>`docs/runbooks/kubernetes.md` |
